body_html:
Great show with no issues. We did run almost an hour behind due to them deciding last minute to do a champagne toast so had to wait for them to pour and pass. Overall good though.”,”Congrats to Rachel and Alex who had an amazing wedding at Pines at Genesee. This was an absolutely beautiful wedding and could not have possibly asked for a nicer day outside. With the ceremony on the Aspen Terrace the moving to the upper level for the reception, it was all incredible and without a doubt a wedding that will never be forgotten. Once again JAMMIN’ DJs was lucky enough to be a part of it and provide top notch entertainment as well.

 

DJ Cameron
